description: Placed on display at the NAS Oceana main gate 28 June 2004 and photographed in place 16 September 2022 per its Aerial Visuals dossier; this is the last F-14D built and is distinct from 164603 the last in Navy service which went to the Cradle of Aviation Museum New York
